checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One ~8s widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
must.why: 16:9 animated plant growing, but no seed is ever shown; a shoot is already up at 0.8s.

must.item: Voice-over says script verbatim, no extras.
Water reaches seed, roots grow downward, shoot grows upward toward light, in that order.
must.why: Shoot is visible first, water is only faint droplets, and roots appear last. The order is wrong, and there is no seed or cross-section.

must.item: Growth stages appear while narration describes them.
must.why: The shoot is already out at 0.8s, when the narration would be on water. Roots show only late. The stages don't match the script.
No text is visible in the frames. Music can't be judged from the numbers.

exact_text.text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text visible, which is correct since none was wanted; this is spoken only.

faults.what: No seed is shown. The shoot is already sprouted in the first frame.
The sequence is wrong: the shoot comes first, water is barely shown, and roots appear last. This contradicts the script order.
The scene is a landscape view of the surface, not the flat cross-section the reply described. The roots appear to float in front of the soil rather than below ground.
The plant is cropped at the top of the frame in the final frames.

summary: The clip is a nicely rendered animation of a plant growing, but it never shows a seed or clear water, the shoot appears before the roots, and the stages don't match the narration order.
